breaks.quote: A list like that is present friction at its quietest
breaks.why: An abstract, crafted phrase that a second-language reader must guess at, in a passage that should explain plainly.

breaks.quote: every day, 2 to 3 hours went to the mundane side of these things
breaks.why: "Mundane" is a higher-register word he would not use and his readers may not know.

breaks.quote: or that one of the side hustles would not turn into a million-dollar business
breaks.why: Nearby, "fruitless endeavour" lifts the register above his plain speech.
